newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Foreign financial holdings in Argentina $21.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Foreign financial holdings in Argentina $21.5 bln.

text.p: The value of Argentine stocks and bonds held by non-resident investors was $21.5 billion in May, up 74.7 percent from May 1996, the National Securities Commission said Friday.
But the value of foreign-held financial investments was down 0.22 percent from April, the commission said in a news release.
Foreigners held Argentine shares worth $7.98 billion in May, up from $5.34 billion in the same month last year, and $7.77 billion in April 1997.

They held government bonds worth $13.37 billion, compared to $6.88 billion a year earlier and $13.67 billion in April. They also held other bonds to a value of $158 million, up from $90 million in May 1996 and $128 million this April.
